import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

def ground_to_world(u, v, X_cam, Y_cam, heading_deg):
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    z_cam = 1.55 * 256.0 / (v - 256.0)
    x_cam = (u - 256.0) * 1.55 / (v - 256.0)
    X_w = X_cam + z_cam * np.sin(theta) + x_cam * np.cos(theta)
    Y_w = Y_cam + z_cam * np.cos(theta) - x_cam * np.sin(theta)
    return X_w, Y_w

# 1. Chairs in obs_0020, obs_0008, obs_0019
# In obs_0020, there is a brown chair in the center.
# Let us find all brown feet touching the ground in obs_0020:
img20 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0020.png"))
# Brown mask:
is_brown20 = (img20[:,:,0] > 70) & (img20[:,:,0] < 170) & (img20[:,:,1] > 30) & (img20[:,:,1] < 110) & (img20[:,:,2] < 60)
# Look at center chair (u in [200, 320])
ys, xs = np.where(is_brown20 & (np.arange(512)[None,:] >= 220) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] <= 320))
print("obs_0020 center chair: bottom v =", ys.max(), "u =", xs[ys == ys.max()].mean())
# Leg contact points:
# The feet touch the floor at the maximum v for each leg:
for v in range(ys.max(), ys.max()-10, -1):
    leg_xs = xs[ys == v]
    if len(leg_xs) > 0:
        print(f"v={v}, xs={leg_xs}")

# In obs_0008 (pos 0,0, heading 315):
img8 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0008.png"))
is_brown8 = (img8[:,:,0] > 70) & (img8[:,:,0] < 170) & (img8[:,:,1] > 30) & (img8[:,:,1] < 110) & (img8[:,:,2] < 60)
# Let find distinct brown objects in obs_0008:
# There is a table on left (u < 260), chair 1 (u around 280-320), chair 2 (u around 420-490)
ys1, xs1 = np.where(is_brown8 & (np.arange(512)[None,:] >= 260) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] <= 330))
print("obs_0008 chair 1: bottom v =", ys1.max(), "u =", xs1[ys1 == ys1.max()].mean())
print("chair 1 world:", ground_to_world(xs1[ys1 == ys1.max()].mean(), ys1.max(), 0, 0, 315))

ys2, xs2 = np.where(is_brown8 & (np.arange(512)[None,:] >= 420))
print("obs_0008 chair 2: bottom v =", ys2.max(), "u =", xs2[ys2 == ys2.max()].mean())
print("chair 2 world:", ground_to_world(xs2[ys2 == ys2.max()].mean(), ys2.max(), 0, 0, 315))

# Table in obs_0007 / obs_0008 / obs_0019:
# obs_0007 (pos 0,0, heading 270):
img7 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0007.png"))
is_brown7 = (img7[:,:,0] > 70) & (img7[:,:,0] < 170) & (img7[:,:,1] > 30) & (img7[:,:,1] < 110) & (img7[:,:,2] < 60)
ys7, xs7 = np.where(is_brown7)
print("obs_0007 table: bottom v =", ys7.max(), "u bounds =", xs7.min(), xs7.max(), "bottom u =", xs7[ys7 == ys7.max()].mean())
print("table world from 0007:", ground_to_world(xs7[ys7 == ys7.max()].mean(), ys7.max(), 0, 0, 270))
